name: lygo-llm-console
description: Sovereign local LLM runtime and agent portal, shipped as an unpacked public kit (console 1.5.9). URL prefetch is off unless you set LYGO_HOST_PREFETCH=1; every mutation needs a token even on loopback. Map scripts: no network/subprocess/writes. Operator runtime: loopback HTTP, HTTPS GET to public hosts, writes only inside its own folder (sessions, receipts and a RAG index are kept there on disk, nothing uploaded, removed with the folder), pinned llama-server subprocess, optional workspace shell/Python (not a sandbox). Not Ollama. No steward vaults, keys or weights.
kit_ship_form: unpacked tree (deliberately not an archive, so every shipped file is inspectable)

operator_runtime_kit.network: https GET to public hosts; loopback, RFC1918, link-local and .internal refused
operator_runtime_kit.subprocess: pinned llama-server.exe from engine/; local python -c and cmd.exe /c without metacharacters
operator_runtime_kit.shell: workspace cwd, P0 gate refuses OS wipe and credential reads; NOT a filesystem sandbox
